# Young tableaux

The Young-tableau toolkit for many-body wavefunctions: tableaux and their tensor form, the Young symmetrizer, inner products, normalization, and orthogonalization of degenerate weight spaces.

### Tableau

`Tableau[rows]`

A Young tableau given as a list of row-lists. Used to specify the Young symmetrizer applied by `TableauPermute`.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `rows` | a list of rows, e.g. {{1, 2}, {3}} |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
Tableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
Tableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TableauPermute[Tableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}], Psi[1, 2, 3]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
Psi[1, 2, 3] + Psi[2, 1, 3] - Psi[2, 3, 1] - Psi[3, 2, 1]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**See also:** [`TableauPermute`](young-tableaux#tableaupermute) · [`TensorTableau`](young-tableaux#tensortableau) · [Guided tour](../walkthrough#young-tableaux-and-wave-functions)

### TensorTableau

`TensorTableau[rows]`

A tensor-product Young tableau with explicit index entries -- a compact notation for a many-body wave function that also displays its permutation symmetry. Linear combinations of `TensorTableau` expressions are the working objects of the toolkit.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `rows` | a list of rows of index entries, e.g. {{1, 2}, {3}} |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
ToTensor[TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
Psi[1, 2, 3] + Psi[2, 1, 3] - Psi[2, 3, 1] - Psi[3, 2, 1]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

### TableauForm

`TableauForm[t]`

Displays a `TensorTableau` (or a linear combination of them) as a labelled Young-tableau grid. This is a display form; use `ToTensor` to get the same state as data.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `t` | a TensorTableau or linear combination |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TableauForm[TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label"></div><div class="cla-example-cell"><div class="cla-example-note">
```

renders as a labelled Young-tableau grid in the notebook front end (top row 1, 2; second row 3). The same state, as data:```{raw} html
</div></div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
ToTensor[TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text

### TableauPermute

`TableauPermute[t, v]`

Applies the Young symmetrizer of the tableau `t` to a basis tensor `v`, giving the (unnormalized) wave function as a combination of `Psi` tensors. A repeated entry within a column makes the result vanish, since columns are antisymmetrized.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `t` | a Tableau giving the symmetry |
| `v` | a Psi basis tensor |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TableauPermute[Tableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}], Psi[1, 1, 2]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
2*Psi[1, 1, 2] - Psi[1, 2, 1] - Psi[2, 1, 1]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**See also:** [`Tableau`](young-tableaux#tableau) · [`Psi`](young-tableaux#psi) · [`ToTensor`](young-tableaux#totensor)

### TableauNormalization

`TableauNormalization[t]`

Normalizes a `TensorTableau` expression to unit norm.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `t` | a TensorTableau or linear combination |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TableauNormalization[TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {2}}]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {2}}]/Sqrt[6]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

### TableauOrthogonalization

`TableauOrthogonalization[t1, t2]`

One Gram-Schmidt step: returns `{t1, t2 - <t2,t1>/<t1,t1> t1}`, keeping `t1` and orthogonalizing `t2` against it. Used to pick a basis for a degenerate (repeated) weight space.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `t1` | a TensorTableau expression to keep |
| `t2` | a TensorTableau expression to orthogonalize against t1 |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TableauOrthogonalization[2 TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}] - TensorTableau[{{1, 3}, {2}}], TensorTableau[{{1, 3}, {2}}] + TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
{2*TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}] - TensorTableau[{{1, 3}, {2}}], 
 (3*TensorTableau[{{1, 3}, {2}}])/2}
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**See also:** [`TableauDot`](young-tableaux#tableaudot) · [`TableauNormalization`](young-tableaux#tableaunormalization) · [Guided tour: orthogonalizing a degenerate weight](../walkthrough#the-11-representation-of-su3)

### TableauDot

`TableauDot[t1, t2]`

The inner product of two `TensorTableau` expressions.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `t1` | a TensorTableau expression |
| `t2` | a TensorTableau expression |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TableauDot[TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}], TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
4
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

### ToTensor

`ToTensor[t]`

Converts a `TensorTableau` (or linear combination) into an explicit linear combination of `Psi` basis tensors.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `t` | a TensorTableau or linear combination |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
ToTensor[TensorTableau[{{1, 2}, {3}}]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
Psi[1, 2, 3] + Psi[2, 1, 3] - Psi[2, 3, 1] - Psi[3, 2, 1]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**See also:** [`TensorTableau`](young-tableaux#tensortableau) · [`Psi`](young-tableaux#psi) · [`TableauPermute`](young-tableaux#tableaupermute)

### TensorDot

`TensorDot[p1, p2]`

The Hermitian inner product of two linear combinations of `Psi` tensors. Distinct basis tensors are orthonormal.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `p1` | a linear combination of Psi tensors |
| `p2` | a linear combination of Psi tensors |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TensorDot[Psi[1, 2, 3], Psi[1, 2, 3]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
1
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TensorDot[Psi[1, 2], Psi[2, 1]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
0
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**See also:** [`TableauDot`](young-tableaux#tableaudot) · [`TensorNorm`](young-tableaux#tensornorm) · [`Psi`](young-tableaux#psi)

### TensorNorm

`TensorNorm[p]`

The norm of a linear combination of `Psi` tensors, i.e. Sqrt[TensorDot[p, p]].

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `p` | a linear combination of Psi tensors |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TensorNorm[Psi[1, 2] + Psi[2, 1]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
Sqrt[2]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

**See also:** [`TensorDot`](young-tableaux#tensordot) · [`TableauNormalization`](young-tableaux#tableaunormalization)

### Psi

`Psi[i1, i2, ...]`

A basis tensor |i1, i2, ...> in the tensor-product space -- the elementary building block of the many-body wave functions. Distinct `Psi` tensors are orthonormal under `TensorDot`.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
| :-- | :-- |
| `i1, i2, ...` | the indices labelling the basis tensor |

**Examples**

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[1]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
Psi[1, 2, 3]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[1]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
Psi[1, 2, 3]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example"><div class="cla-example-row cla-example-in"><div class="cla-example-label">In[2]:=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-input">
```

```mathematica
TensorDot[Psi[1, 2], Psi[1, 2]]
```

```{raw} html
</div></div>
```

```{raw} html
<div class="cla-example-row cla-example-out"><div class="cla-example-label">Out[2]=</div><div class="cla-example-cell cla-example-output">
```

```text
1
```

```{raw} html
</div></div></div>
```
